article.headline: Chicago takes on New York on 5-game skid
article.description: Chicago Bulls (1-6, 13th in the Eastern Conference) vs. New York Knicks (3-4, eighth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Chicago takes on New York on 5-game skid
article.linkText: Chicago takes on New York on 5-game skid
article.story: Chicago Bulls (1-6, 13th in the Eastern Conference) vs. New York Knicks (3-4, eighth in the Eastern Conference) New York; Wednesday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Chicago heads into the matchup with New York as losers of five straight games. New York finished 53-29 overall, 35-17 in Eastern Conference action and 30-10 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Knicks averaged 116.5 points per game last season, 16.8 on free throws and 42.6 from 3-point range. Chicago went 31-51 overall and 19-32 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Bulls averaged 28.5 assists per game on 42.4 made field goals last season. The two teams match up for the second time this season. The Knicks defeated the Bulls 133-127 in their last meeting on Oct. 29. Jalen Brunson led the Knicks with 38 points, and Norman Powell led the Bulls with 30 points. INJURIES: Knicks: None listed. Bulls: Nic Claxton: out (hamstring). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
